title: Sign Text Formatting
body:
This page is for Sign Text Formatting. For Speakers, go to Speaker Text Formatting.

About

Rich text tags are similar to XML/HTML tags where you must include both an opening and closing tag around the text. These allow you to change the font style, type, color, and more, and allow for more diverse and interesting Signs on your plot.

Tags List[1]

Italics: <i>Lorem Ipsum</i> | Makes text within the tags Italic.

Fonts: <font Oswald>Lorem Ipsum</font> | Changes the font of the text. A full list of supported fonts can be found on the Official Roblox Documentation site.

Color: <color ff0000>Lorem Ipsum</color> | Changes the text color to Red. Change "ff0000" to the HEX code of the color without the pound (#) you wish to use. (For example, 32cd32 for Lime Green.)

Stroke: <stroke ff0000>Lorem Ipsum</stroke> | Adds a red outline to text. As with Color, change "ff0000" to the HEX color you want to use.

You can nest multiple tags within each other, as long as the closing tags are in the reverse order. For example, "<font Oswald><i><color ff0000><stroke 000000>This is sample text!</stroke></color></i></font>" would create "This is sample text!" in the Oswald font, italicized, colored red, with a black outline.

Escape Forms[1]

If you want to render certain characters like < or > and exempt them from consideration as part of rich text tags, you can write them in their escape form. Just write the text that's under "Escape" and it should convert it to the Character version on signs in the game.

Table of escape forms, their usages, and outcomes.
Character Escape Example Result
< < x < y x < y
> > x > y y > x
" " "x" "x"
' ' 'xyz' 'xyz'
& & yes & no yes & no

Trivia

  • Rich text tags like Bold (<b></b>), Underline (<u></u>), and Strikethrough (<s></s>) have been tested and unfortunately do not work.
    • Rich text tags that start with Font (such as <font transparency="#"></font>) will not work, as the game only reads the word font at the beginning and assumes it's for a font face.
  • If a rich text tag doesn't work in a sign, it will disappear from the text box entirely when confirmed.
